title: Flow Play Zoom Styling
description: Fix flow play canvas styling breaking on zoom
summary: Fixed flow play zoom styling: added cavas scale_scene_for_device_pixel_ratio and applied it in flow/dag WASM render paths so logical scenes fill physical GPU surfaces on retina; DAG node labels now pick horizontal vs vertical orientation from node aspect ratio instead of forcing vertical at Normal+ LOD (stops labels flipping sideways when crossing zoom bands); flow/dag canvases listen to visualViewport resize for browser zoom DPR updates. WASM rebuilt, flow play validate passes.
